name: OmaGuard
author: nixfred
description: A shield in the bar and your saved bar layouts in one click. Load a layout, and OmaGuard tells you when the bar has unsaved changes to it (Save, Undo, Save as new). The shield only counts problems the live desktop confirms, each with how to fix it.

barWidget.description: One-click bar layouts with Save / Undo, and a shield that only warns about problems the running desktop confirms.

schema.label: Auto-add new widgets
schema.description: When you add a widget to the bar, add it to the loaded layout in the same place. Moves and removals are never saved automatically — they show as unsaved changes.

schema.label: Re-read interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often OmaGuard re-reads its own state so the shield stays current. This only re-reads what is already stored — it does not take a new capture. Captures happen when you press Capture now.

schema.label: Helper timeout (ms)
schema.description: How long OmaGuard waits for omaguard.py before giving up and saying so. A timeout is always reported; it never renders as a healthy shield.
